targets.old_statement: A license expired between 180 days and five years needs a knowledge exam and vision screening on renewal, while one expired five years or more also needs a driving skills exam.
targets.old_spoken_statement: A license expired between one hundred eighty days and five years needs a knowledge exam and vision screening on renewal, while one expired five years or more also needs a driving skills exam.
targets.statement: Renewing a driver's license expired from one hundred eighty days up to five years requires an administrative penalty, a knowledge exam, and a standard vision screening, while one expired five years or longer also requires a driving skills exam.

targets.old_statement: A person aged 15 or older can run a boat over 10 horsepower without a driver's license after an approved boater course, but someone under 15 cannot run one at all.
targets.old_spoken_statement: A person aged fifteen or older can run a boat over ten horsepower without a driver's license after an approved boater course, but someone under fifteen cannot run one at all.
targets.statement: Unlicensed operators aged fifteen or older may run a watercraft exceeding ten horsepower only after completing an approved boater education course and while carrying a valid Indiana identification card, whereas anyone under fifteen is barred from operating one.
